description: Portrait of O'Keeffe walking on the Ghost Ranch Property on a dried up stream- with scattered  large and small rocks along the vertical side of an alluvial fan; she stands in profile looking ahead towards her one of her chows  in front of her; she wears a white head scarf, a black wrap dress, garden gloves and her blue PF Flyers sneakers.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe Walks at the Ghost Ranch
